dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit thin, high-intensity perimeters with sharp transitions to low-intensity interiors; perimeters are irregularly circular and highly distinct on the mid-dorsal surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters localized on the upper right lateral region, forming a dense field of non-gradient spots.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent 'O' rings form a scalene triangle; a secondary cluster of high-intensity blobs forms an irregular polygonal relationship on the anterior-dorsal flank.
